title: A tested match of pack --root _self prints its pinned passage and little else
goal: pack --root _self QUESTION whose verdict is good (a tested question matched) prints the pinned passages, at most three further passages and the tied decisions, so a tested answer costs a fraction of the default budget; a weak pack keeps the full budget, since the agent must find the line itself; the report under kb/_self/reports/ records the bytes of a tested answer before and after

run:
import re, subprocess, sys
try:
    q = "who may answer a sprint's start gate"  # SE-002, lookup_eval.csv:3, verdict good
    r = subprocess.run(["python3", "_tools/rag.py", "pack", "--root", "_self", q], capture_output=True, text=True)
    t = r.stdout
    assert r.returncode == 0, "pack exit %d" % r.returncode
    pinned = t.count("[tested ")
    passages = len(re.findall(r"^- kb/_self/\S+\.md:\d+ ", t, re.M))
    size = len(t.encode())
    # bound: (pinned+3) passages x 450 bytes (longest passage line today) + 561 bytes of header/decision/footer today = 2361 -> 2400
    bound = 2400
    ok = "the operator approves the goal" in t and pinned >= 1 and passages <= pinned + 3 and size < bound
    print("%s: bytes=%d (<%d) passages=%d (<=%d)" % ("ok" if ok else "FAIL", size, bound, passages, pinned + 3))
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
except Exception as e:
    print("check error", e)
    sys.exit(1)

notes: Planning 2026-10-06: the planted check packs the tested question SE-002 (kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv) and asks for at most pinned+3 passages under 2400 bytes, the bound being (1 pinned + 3) x 450 bytes (the longest passage line today) plus 561 bytes of header, decisions and footer; today it prints 12 passages in 4255 bytes. The worker may re-derive the bound in the report the goal asks for.
